description: A subdirectory of an entrypoint holds a spec and a source, both with a `<video>` in a string, and 1.2.1 keeps resting on the scan. A spec reaches no consumer and the reader leaves it out at any depth, so the refusal names the source, listed after it by name; a reader that took the spec names the spec's line first. Laid on disk and read by the live reader (`tree`).
